entry.title: v0.40.17
entry.content:
Inkling 2 Mini

Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines is a 26B parameter model with 5.4B active.

Its looped layers give it more computation per token than its size suggests, and it still fits on a Mac at about 20GB. It handles text and images, tool calls, and thinking, and scores 79.2% on SWE-Bench Verified).

  ollama run inkling-2-mini

Note: inkling-2-mini is supported on Apple silicon only in this release. PC support will follow in an upcoming release.

What's Changed

  • ollama launch claude supports Claude Code's deferred tool loading, so MCP tools are loaded when needed instead of all at
    once

  • Ollama on Apple silicon now serves multiple requests at once.

  • ollama launch opencode sets thinking options from the model's metadata

  • ollama launch pi refreshes Pi's model list after sign-in and passes along prompt arguments

  • ollama launch chatgpt --restore asks before switching an active profile and preserves existing settings and chat history;
    quitting ChatGPT yourself now lets it exit through its own quit prompt

  • Running ollama with no arguments in a non-interactive shell prints help instead of erroring

  • Ctrl+C or Ctrl+G while in a multiline """ block leaves multiline mode instead of swallowing the next line

  • Changing the context shift setting no longer reloads the model

  • Vulkan now uses mmap for integrated GPUs, fixing Failed to allocate pinned memory load failures on shared-memory GPUs

  • On Windows iGPUs, partially offloaded models no longer fail to allocate the KV cache

  • Tool definitions passed through the API keep JSON schema keywords Ollama doesn't model instead of dropping them

  • Disabling thinking now maps to the model's lowest supported reasoning level rather than being ignored

  • Source builds can use prebuilt MLX-C and XGrammar binaries

    Full Changelog: v0.40.16...v0.40.17-rc3

entry.title: v0.40.17-rc2: mlxrunner: adapt saved history to memory pressure (#19678)
entry.content:
• mlxrunner: adapt saved history to memory pressure

Retain Metal prefix history using observed memory headroom and execution
workspace rather than a fixed 8 GiB allowance. Release unused buffers and
cold history when system compression grows, preserving reusable paths and
active requests.

Cover pressure reclamation, snapshot ownership, memory observation, and
cacheless request isolation.

entry.title: v0.40.17-rc1: mlxrunner: batch speculative verification (#19663)
entry.content:
• mlxrunner: batch speculative verification

Keep drafting active for concurrent generation by sharing target verification while preserving per-request sampling and cache rollback. Learn draft depth for each concurrent workload separately from isolated requests, and preserve probes that short requests never execute.

Materialize owned target features before a reader can pause, and cover acceptance, cancellation, handoffs, mixed decoding and retained-memory boundaries.

entry.title: v0.40.16
entry.content:
Ripple Preview

Ripple Preview from Ricursive Intelligence is a 65B dense model built for agentic coding.

ollama run ripple-preview

What's Changed

  • Qwen3.8 Flash Next uses about 27 GiB less memory on Apple silicon
  • ollama launch claude always routes Claude Code to the selected model
  • ollama launch explains when a cloud model has been retired
  • /v1/responses respects truncation and no longer silently truncates by default
  • /v1/models returns an empty list instead of null when no models are installed
  • CUDA 13.5 support for Windows on ARM
  • Updated llama.cpp

Full Changelog: v0.40.15...v0.40.16

entry.title: v0.40.15
entry.content:
MiMo V2.6

Xiaomi MiMo's mimo-v2.6, a 9B model built for code and agent workflows, is now supported in Ollama.

ollama run mimo-v2.6

AutoTrust decision models

AutoTrust decision models read text and return choices, yes or no probabilities, and ratings for the questions you supply. The family includes 9b, 35b, and 27b-vl sizes — the 35b and 27b-vl sizes can also read images.

ollama run autotrust-jev "A customer says their card was charged twice." --ask "Is this a billing issue?"

Note: autotrust-jev is supported on Apple silicon in this release.

What's Changed

  • ollama launch now supports Kimi Code CLI — the successor to kimi-cli — and offers to migrate existing kimi-cli setups
  • ollama launch now fills in Pi's model list automatically so models can be picked inside Pi, and Claude Desktop's model
    picker shows Ollama's actual model names
  • Recurrent and vision GGUF models can now serve more than one request at a time
  • Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 models using long-context (YaRN) scaling
  • Running ollama with no arguments opens the welcome launcher

Full Changelog: v0.40.14...v0.40.15
